description.en: Signs in and manages accounts for 16 AI coding providers, plus a cross-provider rotation channel: multi-account pools, automatic credential refresh, credit claiming where the provider offers it, and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 登录并管理 16 个 AI 编程服务商的账号，另含一个跨渠道轮换渠道：多账号池、凭据自动续期、服务商支持时的积分领取，以及本地 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: Remote control for DSH: a Devices panel that discovers other DSH desktops signed into the same account, pairs with them once, and drives their sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用手机网页远程操控另一台桌面，支持审批、文件预览和离线通知。

description.en: ChatGPT plan connection for DeepSeek Harness through Sign in with ChatGPT      通过官方接口将你的ChatGPT订阅接入dsh使用
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT 账号授权登录，把 ChatGPT 订阅接入 DSH，支持文字、图片、工具调用和多账号。

description.en: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上输入预测：回合结束后自动建议你的下一句话，Tab 一键采纳；输入时按会话历史做前缀补全。（输入预测 / 自动补全 / 提示词建议 / 补全）

description.en: 给 DSH 出网前加一道护栏：按 provider 分档的提示词指纹同义改写（system/messages/tools/toolHistory 四个面）+ 软拒绝带加固重试。provider 无关，装一次对全模型生效。
description.zh: 给 DSH 出网加一道护栏，按 provider 分档改写提示词指纹并软拒绝重试，装一次全模型生效。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for 得到大脑（Get笔记）
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接用自然语言搜索、保存和整理得到大脑笔记，装好就能用，不用配 API Key。

description.en: Spaces for DeepSeek Harness — switch DSH workspaces like Discord servers.
description.zh: 像切换 Discord 服务器一样切换 DSH 工作区，桌面端隔离运行，配置互不干扰。

description.en: Brings Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent models into DeepSeek Harness — 12 models including GLM-5.2, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek-V4.1 and Kimi-K3, with image input, tool calls, thinking levels and a daily check-in button. Speaks the gateway's signed and SM4-GCM encrypted protocol directly; the CodeArts desktop client does not need to run.
description.zh: 把华为云码道（CodeArts Agent）的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness —— 12 个模型（GLM-5.2、GLM-5.3、DeepSeek-V4.1、Kimi-K3 等），支持图片输入、工具调用、思考强度与每日签到。直接与网关的签名 + SM4-GCM 加密协议对话，不需要码道客户端在运行。

description.en: Tag-based long-term memory for DSH agents.

Keeps the user's standing rules in every model-step prompt (global / workspace / session) or in AGENTS.md, lists bundled secrets, and shows which websites still have a saved login in each local browser (Edge / Chrome / 360). 常驻钥则：三层规则每步注入（外加 AGENTS.md 第四项

Subtask-tree context manager for DeepSeek Harness (@spinejit/dsh-spinejit): adds spine_open, spine_close, spine_next and spine_spawn tools so the agent works on a persistent SpineTree, replaces closed subtasks with their submitted memories while keeping active work and earlier prefix tokens intact, and renders the live tree in the Web/Desktop input dock and dsh-tui status rows.
description.zh: DSH 子任务树上下文管理插件（@spinejit/dsh-spinejit）：提供 spine_open、spine_close、spine_next 与 spine_spawn 工具维护持久化 SpineTree，在保留当前活跃步骤与前序前缀不变的同时将已闭合子任务折叠为提交结论，并在 Web/Desktop 输入栏与 dsh-tui 状态行实时展示任务树。

description.en: ARIS research-workflow skills as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: 82 skills plus cross-model adversarial review through Codex.
把 DSH 的会话库管起来：迁移工作区与会话到新目录，导出 / 导入 .dshsess 会话包，用 WebDAV 在多台机器之间同步。
description.zh: 把工作区和会话迁移到新目录，支持导出导入会话包，还能用 WebDAV 在多台机器间同步。

description.en: An ASCII ocean behind the New Session screen of DeepSeek Harness — fish schools that flee, orcas that hunt, themed and translucent. Engine ported from stackedlol/ascii-sharks (see NOTICE.md).
Controls tool visibility by DSH agent preset, with group and per-tool switches and a separate group for each registered global MCP server.
description.zh: 按 DSH 角色管理工具可见性，支持整组开关和逐工具设置，并为每个已注册工具的全局 MCP 服务器单独分组。

description.en: Mobile Web PWA and Feishu remote control hub for DeepSeek Harness (plus optional local adapters for Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy and Doubao): starts an embedded HTTP hub on 0.0.0.0:8788 gated by a bearer token and 6-character pairing code, with session switching, file browsing, media preview, tool approvals, Web Push notifications, and optional outbound relay to a self-hosted Cloud Hub or Feishu bot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的手机端 Web PWA 与飞书远程控制中心（可选接入本机 Antigravity、Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy 与豆包）：默认在 0.0.0.0:8788 启动受令牌与 6 位配对码保护的局域网网关，支持会话切换、文件浏览与媒体预览、工具审批、Web Push 推送，以及可选外连自建云端 Hub 或飞书机器人长连接。

description.en: Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work

Measured self-improvement for prompts, skills, code and config: versions the editable files, runs paired experiments against the current version, gates changes on measured noise, cost and latency, and confirms adoptions on a sealed holdout, reverting them when confirmation fails. Adds the evokit stdio MCP tools and three skills (onboard, evolve, meta); the MCP server is the Python engine from PyPI (uv tool install dsh-evokit).
description.zh: 可度量的自我改进：对提示词、技能、代码与配置做版本管理，与当前版本做配对实验，按实测噪声、成本和延迟设门槛，并在封存的留出集上确认采纳，确认不通过即回退。接入 evokit 的 stdio MCP 工具和 onboard/evolve/meta 三个技能；MCP 服务端是 PyPI 上的 Python 引擎（uv tool install dsh-evokit）。

description.en: Adds Google Antigravity as a DSH model provider: it drives the official agy ACP server over stdio, so Gemini 4 Argon/Hydrogen, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 show up in the model picker. Tool calls execute back in DSH through a private loopback MCP bridge. Extra accounts get an isolated HOME and log in through browser OAuth in the settings page; plan quota is read per account.
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity 接成 DSH 的模型提供方：通过 stdio 驱动官方 agy ACP server，模型选择器里出现 Gemini 4 Argon/Hydrogen、Gemini 3.8 Flash 与 Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5。工具调用经私有 loopback MCP 桥回到 DSH 执行；新增账号使用隔离的 HOME，在设置页里走浏览器授权，额度按账号读取。

description.en: Robots-aware web information gathering for agents and analysts: multi-engine search over 360, Bing, Sogou and WeChat, HTML/PDF/Office/EPUB/RSS converted to clean Markdown, Bilibili/Zhihu/Xiaohongshu/WeChat pages read through dedicated adapters, sitemap discovery, and resumable link-by-link surfing. A browser mode drives a real browser through eight read-only playbooks for rendered pages and login-state sites. Fetched text is marked untrusted, instruction-shaped content is flagged, robots.txt is respected by default at one request per second per origin. Ships a CLI, two MCP servers and a Claude Code skill.
description.zh: 给 Agent 与分析者的 robots-aware 网页信息抓取：360 / Bing / 搜狗 / 微信多引擎搜索，HTML/PDF/Office/EPUB/RSS 转成干净的 Markdown，B 站 / 知乎 / 小红书 / 公众号走专门适配器阅读，sitemap 发现，以及可续跑的逐链 surf。浏览器模式通过八个只读剧本驱动真实浏览器，处理渲染页与登录态站点。抓回的正文标记为不可信，指令形状的内容会被标出；默认遵守 robots.txt，每站点每秒一个请求。含 CLI、两个 MCP 服务和一个 Claude Code 技能。

description.en: Run commands on other machines from a DSH session: a small dshnc client on each node connects out over a websocket and declares shell, job, session and files APIs, while the server adds nodes_list, nodes_catalog, nodes_api and nodes_call plus an admin panel. Every command runs in an ro, rw or full sandbox whose ceiling is a policy, and widening it needs an explicit human decision; all decisions are audited. Files move in chunks, assembled as `<path>.inprogress`, verified by SHA-256 on both ends and confined to the directories the calling session may touch.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里操作其他机器：每个节点跑一个小客户端 dshnc，主动连出并声明 shell / job / session / files 四类 API；服务端提供 nodes_list、nodes_catalog、nodes_api、nodes_call 以及一块管理面板。每条命令都在 ro / rw / full 沙箱下执行，权限上限由策略决定，放宽需要人来拍板，所有决定写入审计日志。文件分块传输，经 `<path>.inprogress` 组装，两端做 SHA-256 校验，且只能落在发起会话有权访问的目录内。
把课程讲义一键导出成 OCX 和 PDF，老师做课件省心多了。

description.en: Natural-language CAD and a printable-mesh toolchain in one plugin. The local SolidCraft CLI turns a prompt or an edit into a design; seven actions (probe, model, measure, snapshot, script, inspect, repair) then measure it, render a snapshot, and export a printable mesh through one gate record with the same exit codes. Thirty Blender skills cover what never has a dimensioned part: organic modelling, materials, lighting, cameras, rendering, UV and animation. Mesh inspection reports winding, degenerate faces and bounds before a part reaches a printer, and a missing SolidCraft yields an explicit UNVERIFIED instead of a silent pass. Every action returns typed JSON byte-identical to the file on disk.
description.zh: 一句话建模加可打印网格的一体化插件。本地 SolidCraft CLI 把提示词或修改变成设计；七个动作（probe、model、measure、snapshot、script、inspect、repair）随后测量、出快照、导出可打印网格，全部走同一份门记录与同一套退出码。三十个 Blender 技能覆盖那些没有尺寸零件的工作：有机建模、材质、灯光、相机、渲染、UV 与动画。网格检查会在零件送去打印前报出绕序、退化面与包围盒；SolidCraft 缺失时明确给出 UNVERIFIED，而不是静默通过。每个动作返回的 JSON 与磁盘上的文件逐字节一致。

description.en: Replace the plain question card with a consequence-aware panel: options carry what choosing them changes (files, behaviour, risk, cost), hovering one opens that preview with room to read and scroll, a note typed there rides along with the answer, and Cancel becomes a real decision — a card that either hands the call back to the agent or halts the turn through concludesTurn instead of quietly closing.
description.zh: 把出厂提问卡换成「带代价」的面板：每个选项都带着选它之后会发生什么（改哪些文件、影响哪些行为、风险、几轮），悬停即展开可读可滚的预览，在预览里写下的意见随答案回传；取消不再是静默关闭，而是一张接管卡——要么把决定权交回智能体，要么用 concludesTurn 真正停住这一轮。

description.en: Shows model provider balances and subscription quotas for DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, StepFun, Novita and Xiaomi MiMo in the DSH sidebar and settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏与设置页集中显示 DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、StepFun、Novita、小米 MiMo 等平台的余额与订阅额度。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa and Parallel search MCP endpoints (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp and https://mcp.parallel.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge, giving DSH Exa search and fetch tools plus Parallel search, fetch and vertical-data tools. Both endpoints are anonymous and need no API key.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接同时接入 Exa 与 Parallel 两个托管搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai 与 mcp.parallel.ai），提供 Exa 的搜索与抓取工具，以及 Parallel 的搜索、抓取与垂直数据工具。两个端点均匿名可用，无需 API key。

description.en: Zero-token update checks for DSH plugins, DSH Desktop and core: live progress, one-click updates, DSH NEXT migration guard and per-version ignore.
description.zh: 启动时自动检查 DSH 插件、桌面端和核心的更新，不调用智能体、不消耗 token。

description.en: Search ten free literature sources from DSH: the model runs and refines the search while the sidebar shows results, rounds and full-text availability, and you can download PDFs, export citations or save papers to Zotero from either side.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里检索十家免费文献库：模型主导检索并改条件重搜，右侧栏同步展示结果、轮次与全文可用性，对话或界面都能下载 PDF、导出引文、存入 Zotero。

description.en: Set a fixed width for the main conversation in DeepSeek Harness on web and desktop using a slider or an exact pixel value, then hide the controls while keeping your width setting.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版和桌面版中，用滑杆或精确像素值固定主会话正文宽度，设好后可隐藏控件并保留宽度设置。

description.en: DSH Memory stores project and user memories as local Markdown, with a management page, relationship graphs, and backup and recovery tools.
description.zh: DSH Memory 将项目级和用户级记忆存为本地 Markdown，提供记忆管理页、关系图及备份恢复工具。

description.en: Browser bridge for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+, used with its companion Chrome/Brave/Firefox extension: the agent reads and operates tabs in the user's own browser (snapshot, click, type, navigate, extract tables). Each page action waits for an approval card that names the element, or runs without asking in the opt-in Auto approve mode. A fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser. The extension is loaded separately and paired with a code typed into DSH.
description.zh: 浏览器桥接（需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+），配合 Chrome/Brave/Firefox 配套扩展使用：Agent 在你自己的浏览器里读取并操作标签页（快照、点击、输入、跳转、提取表格）。每次页面操作都要先通过点名具体元素的确认卡；开启可选的“自动批准”后则无需逐次确认。fork 自 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。扩展需另行加载，并用在 DSH 里输入的配对码配对。

description.en: Turns a fragmented Markdown docs folder into a few authoritative documents and archives the rest; never deletes files and rolls back byte-for-byte via a per-run journal, with or without git.
description.zh: 一句话把碎片化的 Markdown 文档收束成少数权威文档，其余归档——永不删除，不依赖 git 也能一键逐字节回滚。

description.en: A sticky-note wall: say "I have an idea" in a conversation and the plugin summarizes it, tags it, and pins it to the wall.
description.zh: 一面便签墙：在会话里说「我有一个灵感」，插件自动总结、打标签并挂到墙上。

description.en: WeRead notes, deeply wired into DSH and AI workflows: incremental Markdown sync and export of highlights, ideas and reviews, full-text search with chapter provenance, reading insights (streaks, deep-read ratio, category radar, monthly report), SM-2 note roaming, recent-reading context injected into every model turn, an in-session weread agent tool (sync/search/insights/roaming/stats/store/recommend), an @微信读书 book picker in the composer, clickable tool-result cards, and a cross-host MCP server (9 tools). Three login channels (QR / cookie / official API key), multi-account with instant switching, credentials stay on-device; the loopback API is host-caller authenticated and fail-closed, and the single-reader window ships selected text straight into a DSH session via ask-DSH. Requires DSH >=0.2.0.
description.zh: 微信读书笔记 × DSH/AI 工作流：增量同步导出 Markdown（划线/想法/书评）、带章节出处的全文搜索、阅读洞察（连续天数/深读比/分类雷达、月报）、SM-2 笔记漫游；近期阅读自动注入每轮模型上下文，会话内 weread Agent 工具（同步/搜索/洞察/漫游/统计/书城/荐书），@微信读书 输入触发器选书，工具结果渲染为可点卡片，附跨宿主 MCP 服务（9 工具）。三通道登录（扫码/cookie/官方 API Key）、多账号秒切、凭据仅存本机；本地 API 宿主调用方认证、fail-closed；单例阅读窗口「问 DSH」把选中文本直接送进 DSH 会话。要求 DSH >=0.2.0。

description.en: Three agent presets in one bundle: software development, game development, and read-only discussion, plus per-session isolation and quiet-run switches. Ships delivery and engine workflow skills for Godot, Unity, Unreal and Cocos. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 一次安装新增三个 Agent 预设：软件开发、游戏开发、只读讨论，并带每会话的隔离与静默运行开关；随包附带交付流程与 Godot / Unity / Unreal / Cocos 引擎工作流技能。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Branching multi-step questions with back-navigation, cross-session messaging, and audio and image previews in the file sidebar.
description.zh: 分支式多步提问（可返回上一题）、跨会话消息，以及文件侧边栏的音频与图片预览。

description.en: Composer enhancement: put images or files where you mean them and the model reads each one at that exact position.
description.zh: 输入框增强：把图片或文件放在你想要的位置，模型就在该位置读到它。

description.en: Adds an interactive sequence workbench to DeepSeek Harness for exploring biological sequences, comparing alignments, and viewing Sanger chromatograms. Agents can open files, analyze sequences, and answer questions about the current selection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加交互式生物序列工作台，可浏览序列、比较比对结果和查看 Sanger 测序峰图，也能让 Agent 打开文件、分析序列，并回答与当前选区相关的问题。

description.en: Frosted-glass appearance studio: adjustable transparency and blur, image or video backgrounds, six light/dark surface palettes, type sizes for text, code, and terminal, and optional branding.
description.zh: 毛玻璃外观工作室：可调透明度与模糊度、图片或视频背景、六套浅色/深色表面配色、正文/代码/终端字号，以及可选的品牌标记。

description.en: Per-target retries, streaming-safe fallback chains and a persistent circuit breaker for LLM routes in DeepSeek Harness, with live target status and a settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 路由提供按 target 重试、流式安全回退链与持久化熔断，并带实时 target 状态和设置页。

description.en: DSH usage dashboard: per-model, per-session and per-date token and cost statistics, cache-hit rate and balance widgets in the Web UI.
description.zh: DSH 用量看板：在 Web UI 展示按模型、会话与日期的 token 用量与成本统计、缓存命中率与余额组件。

description.en: Whale Dream is a theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It replaces the app palette with a deep-sea colour set, draws an ASCII whale backdrop behind the conversation, and plays a short whale-leap startup screen while the app boots. Light and dark skins are both included and follow the app's own appearance setting.
description.zh: 鲸梦是一款 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件：用深海配色替换应用配色，在对话背后绘制字符鲸鱼背景，并在启动时播放一段跃鲸开场动画。包含浅色与深色两套皮肤，跟随应用自身的外观设置切换。

description.en: A whale-girl desktop pet in the corner of DSH Web: click her and she recalls one real thing you and your agents did, quoting your own words; lines come from local templates, or from your own configured model if you opt in. Also adds an agent year-in-review page.
description.zh: 住在 DSH Web 右下角的鲸鱼娘桌宠：点她一下，她翻出一件你和 agent 一起干过的真事，带你的原话；台词默认来自本机模板，你同意后可以用自己配置的模型来写。另带一个 agent 年度回顾页。

description.en: Reasoning-effort picker for DeepSeek Harness: one small judge call per message, a 120-character task card, and a per-conversation switch.
description.zh: 根据任务自动调整 DeepSeek 推理强度，省成本又不牺牲效果

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and today's peak/off-peak token rates in the DeepSeek Harness composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里直接看 DeepSeek 账户余额和今天的峰谷时段 token 价格，花钱心里有数。

description.en: Jira ticket intake for DeepSeek Harness: Settings page for the site and API token, /jira-do ticket-to-branch hand-off, /jira-comment, and the jira_ticket and jira_comment tools.
description.zh: 把 Jira 工单接进 DSH：配好站点和 API Token，就能一键把工单转成分支、发评论，还能让 AI 直接读写工单。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件，将聊天界面中失败的assistant attempts (assistant/attempt) 呈现为可折叠的模块，并可选地重新注入对话上下文
description.zh: 把聊天里失败被丢掉的模型输出折叠展示出来，还能一键塞回对话继续用。

description.en: DSH 0.2.x 压缩调度层：单一 owner 持有 ctx.compaction，先免费定向修剪旧工具结果，再决定机械切或让位给 billion-context 的 wire 层；每次删除都有 shadow 备份可召回。MIT。
description.zh: 统一管理上下文压缩，先免费修剪旧工具结果，删了还能召回，省 token 又安全。

description.en: Suggests your next message after each turn and finishes the half-typed sentence inside the DSH composer, tidying typos and punctuation as it goes.
description.zh: 回合结束后给出下一句，打字时补完后半句，顺手修好错字和标点。

description.en: OCR/ASR extraction bridge for DSH Cortex: Windows OCR, Tesseract, optional local PaddleOCR and whisper.cpp.
description.zh: 给 DSH Cortex 补上本地 OCR 和语音转文字能力，图片、音频里的内容都能提取出来。

description.en: Edit sent messages in DeepSeek Harness: press the pencil, rewrite in place, and the corrected text continues in a new branch while the original conversation stays untouched.
description.zh: 发错消息不用重开对话，点铅笔就地改写，修正内容走新分支，原对话原样保留。

description.en: Strategy parameter optimization for DeepSeek Harness — grid sweeps with fee-aware backtests, train/test split, overfit-gap column and multiple-testing discounts. Implements the core concept of Jesse (MIT). Not affiliated.
description.zh: 在真实数据上网格扫描策略参数，用带手续费的回测和训练/测试拆分，直接暴露过拟合差距。

description.en: K-line scenario forecasting for DeepSeek Harness — seeded, reproducible bootstrap fans (P10-P90) from real history; the zero-dependency statistical baseline that neural foundation models must beat. The concept slot of Kronos (47.9k★, MIT). Not affiliated.
description.zh: 基于真实历史K线生成可复现的随机情景扇形预测，作为神经基础模型必须超越的统计基线。

description.en: Deterministic multi-source literature harvesting for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 一次调用搜遍四个学术索引，自动找到开放获取 PDF，证据够了就停，省时又省心。

description.en: Milestone dashboard that keeps a project's intent on disk next to the code: one swimlane per project showing project vision → milestone → capability → execution records, a candidate-capability pool with reasoning, per-node structured prompts previewed before they are sent, DSH sessions launched from the node that needs them with plan/execute/reflect loops, and the live status of the dev services behind the project. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把项目意图存到代码旁边的里程碑看板：每个项目一条泳道，展示项目愿景 → 里程碑 → 能力 → 执行记录，含带推理的候选能力池、发送前可预览的节点结构化提示词、从需要它的节点发起 DSH 会话并走计划/执行/反思闭环，以及后台开发服务的实时状态。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Import existing MCP configurations from Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor, VS Code / Copilot, Copilot CLI, Windsurf, Gemini CLI and OpenCode into DeepSeek Harness, search the official MCP registry, then manage the servers from Settings with connection checks and secrets stored in the DSH credential service.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Cursor、VS Code / Copilot、Copilot CLI、Windsurf、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 的 MCP 配置导入 DeepSeek Harness，搜索官方 MCP Registry，并在设置页管理这些服务：保存前验证连接，密钥写入 DSH 凭证服务。

description.en: Notebook reproducibility capture for DeepSeek Harness: reads .ipynb JSON without executing it, reports kernel/language, code vs markdown cells, execution order (out-of-order and never-run cells), imports, runtime installs, seeds, absolute paths and output state; hashes the notebook and environment declarations; writes REP evidence and a record; ren
description.zh: 不运行代码，只读 .ipynb 文件，帮你查清内核、执行顺序和导入，判断 notebook 是否可复现。

description.en: Bridges QQ (OneBot 11) into DeepSeek Harness with in-chat tools and rich media, and ships its own speech-to-text bridge so voice messages transcribe without a whisper CLI.
description.zh: 把 QQ（OneBot 11）接进 DeepSeek Harness，带群聊工具与富媒体发送，并自带语音转写桥——没装 whisper CLI 也能把收进来的语音转成文字。

description.en: Doubao (豆包) models as a DSH LLM provider: plain HTTPS by default, signed client bridge only when risk control appears, tool calls bridged through a prompt marker protocol.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接用豆包模型，扫码登录一次就能选模型对话，还支持工具调用。

description.en: 将本地已有的dsh插件打包，拷贝到其他电脑通过脚本直接安装或更新
Read assistant answers aloud in DeepSeek Harness. 318 neural voices, a male voice picked automatically for your language, and a voice and speed your agent can change from the chat.
description.zh: 点一下就能把助手回答读出来，支持318种神经网络语音，还能在聊天里换声音调语速。

description.en: Seven research SOP skills for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上七套科研标准流程技能，每步都产出记录或明确结论，不做空谈。

description.en: Reviewer-response workflow for DeepSeek Harness: parse reviewer comments (Reviewer/Referee/审稿人 headers, numbered or paragraph mode) with locators, check point-by-point coverage by response number (missing, too short, extra, duplicates), and export a Markdown response letter with a coverage table. Parsed reviews become REP evidence; coverage counts
description.zh: 自动解析审稿人意见，按编号逐条核对回复信是否全覆盖，避免漏答。

description.en: Retraction and correction monitoring for DeepSeek Harness: Crossref work records plus the verified filter=updates query, per-DOI status (retracted/concern/corrected/notice/clear/unknown), an append-only timeline with change detection, REP v1 evidence snapshots and SARIF output. clear means no registered notice, never proof of validity.
description.zh: 自动盯梢你引用的论文，一旦被撤稿、更正或挂上关注标记就提醒你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：在客户端左侧边栏新增 「技能开关」 页面，给每个已安装技能一个共享的开关。
description.zh: 在侧边栏加个技能开关页，一键统一开关已安装技能，管理更省心。

description.en: Chinese-literature tooling for DeepSeek Harness without scraping: import RIS/EndNote-style or labeled (题名：/作者：/来源：) exports into stable records, format GB/T 7714-2015 (顺序编码制) or APA 7 citations (no invented fields), and run structural metadata validation (missing fields, implausible year, malformed DOI, duplicates). No CNKI login, no scraping, no C
description.zh: 导入中文文献导出文件，自动生成 GB/T 7714 或 APA 7 格式引文，不用爬知网。

description.en: Replays the diff of the edit that just landed in a right-sidebar tab, revealing it line by line behind a moving scan line, with a second tab that lists every file the last round changed. What is replayed is the finished edit, not live model output. Unified or side-by-side layout, wrapping and copying the diff text.
description.zh: 在右侧栏标签页里把刚落地的编辑逐行回放，扫描线经过处才显示改动；另一页列出最近一轮改过的全部文件。回放的是已完成的编辑，不是模型的实时输出。支持单栏或左右对比、自动换行与复制 diff 文本。

description.en: Refuses every conversation model call and streams back “恭喜你，又省下了token！” instead, so a turn spends no tokens; a settings page counts how many calls it has refused. Requests that declare a purpose, such as chat titles and compaction, are left alone. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 拦下每一次对话模型调用，直接流回「恭喜你，又省下了token！」，于是一轮对话不花任何 token；设置页累计显示已拦下的调用次数。带 purpose 的后台请求（标题生成、上下文压缩等）不受影响。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Free TokenBank GLM models in one click: register for a free API key with a $5 credit, models go straight into the model list with protocol and capabilities auto-configured; balance, daily check-in, key deposits (temporary quota to permanent balance, upstream probe) and CNY recharge via Alipay. No self-hosted relay needed.
description.zh: 一键用上 TokenBank 免费模型：注册领免费 API Key 送 $5 体验金，模型直接进模型列表（协议与能力自动配置）；自带余额、每日签到、密钥托管（闲置临时额度转永久余额，带上游探活）与人民币充值（支付宝）。无需自建中转。

description.en: Minimalist element hider for DeepSeek Harness powered by uBlock Origin's cosmetic selector engine.
description.zh: 用 uBlock Origin 的隐藏规则把 DSH 界面里多余的界面元素藏起来，让界面更清爽。

description.en: Inspect and control the UI that other plugins register into DeepSeek Harness slots (placeholder release).
description.zh: 查看并控制其他插件注册到 DSH 界面插槽里的 UI，方便调试和调整界面。

description.en: 词元工坊（DSH）插件：访问 USTC 模型与校内站点时走 ustc-iwan，其余流量保持原样，与 Clash TUN / WireGuard / Panabit iWAN 共存。
description.zh: 访问 USTC 模型和校内站点时自动走 ustc-iwan，其他流量照常，还能和 Clash TUN、WireGuard 等共存。

description.en: A left-sidebar live console for DeepSeek Harness: persona script, stream log, Bilibili danmaku, edge-tts speech, memory inbox. Windows.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏开个直播台，看戏本、弹幕、语音和记忆候选，模型能开播说话记事。

description.en: Salary records for DSH: track pay components, deductions and net pay by pay date, with monthly stats and a full-width records view.
description.zh: DSH 工资记录：按发薪日期记录工资构成、社保与个税扣款、实发金额，支持年度统计与按月聚合。

description.en: 本地优先的 DeepSeek Harness 开发者工具箱：ASCII、编码转换、密码生成、JSON、颜色、时间戳、UUID、哈希｜A local-only developer toolbox for DSH
description.zh: 开发者常用的 14 个小工具合集，全在浏览器本地算，不联网不改配置，打开就能用。

description.en: Free Numes models in DeepSeek Harness: hard zero-cost route (:free + max_price guards), never-give-up retries (5s to 5m), auto-discovery. Zero-dependency local proxy.

The business-to-agent marketplace. One MCP endpoint for 3,200+ APIs across social, SEO/search, company/leads, finance and legal, plus 168+ AI models for chat, reasoning, image, video and audio—including GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Midjourney, Veo and Kling. Browse free; pay per call.
Zero-drift prompt & policy compiler, transactional rollback executor, and adaptive delivery sessions for Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — zero runtime dependencies.
Local-first AI livestream console with character previews, Douyin interactions, governed memory and training, and configuration backup.
description.zh: 本地优先的 AI 直播控制台，支持角色预览、抖音互动、受控记忆与训练及配置备份。

description.en: Recommends up to ten GitHub repositories daily with a configurable count and saves selected repositories to categorized Markdown.
description.zh: 每天按配置推荐最多 10 个 GitHub 仓库，支持将选中的仓库按分类保存到 Markdown。

description.en: Subscription-driven outbound proxy for DSH. Import a Clash / mihomo subscription, a base64 node list, or a single v2rayN node link (vless://, vmess://, ss://, trojan://, …), including IPv6-only v2rayN links that publish no IPv4 address. Runs a local mihomo core and routes the DSH process's own network traffic through the selected node. Binds only to 127.0.0.1, filters skip-cert-verify nodes by default, and masks subscription tokens.
description.zh: DSH 的订阅驱动出站代理。支持导入 Clash / mihomo 订阅、Base64 节点列表，以及 v2rayN 单节点链接（vless://、vmess://、ss://、trojan:// 等），包括只有 IPv6 地址、没有 IPv4 地址的纯 IPv6 v2rayN 链接。本地运行 mihomo 内核，让 DSH 进程自身的网络流量走所选节点。仅绑定 127.0.0.1，默认过滤关闭证书校验的节点，订阅令牌脱敏。

description.en: Global file search in DeepSeek Harness backed by the local Everything (voidtools) index through a bundled es.exe CLI: three entry points (sidebar panel, session header bar and a full-panel overlay), custom relevance scoring, a 50-entry collapsible history and 9 loopback-only HTTP routes. Degrades to an empty soft result, not an error, when Everything, es.exe or the host web server is missing. Windows only.
description.zh: 基于本机 Everything（voidtools）索引、经随附 es.exe CLI 的全盘文件搜索：三处入口（侧边栏面板、会话标题栏、全屏浮层）、自研相关度打分、50 条可折叠历史与 9 条仅回环监听的 HTTP 路由。Everything、es.exe 或宿主 web 服务缺失时降级为空结果而非报错。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Caps the routed model's context window from a chip on the right of the composer (32k / 64k / 128k / 256k / 512k / 1M, plus a revert) by writing the provider's own contextWindow setting, so automatic compaction fires earlier and a long conversation stops pushing each request to the full window.
description.zh: 在对话框右侧加一枚控件，把当前模型的上下文窗口限制在 32k / 64k / 128k / 256k / 512k / 1M（可一键恢复默认），写入提供方自己的 contextWindow 设置，于是自动压缩提前触发，长对话不再把单次请求顶到满窗口。

description.en: Capture ideas, anywhere: the Ideas manager brings an idea backlog straight into the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 把灵感随手丢进看板，AI 帮你收集、评分和整理，想法不再散落各处。

description.en: Skills & MCP panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: grouped by origin, searchable, hot-toggleable.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里集中管理技能和 MCP，按来源分组、可搜索、一键开关。

description.en: Claude-style palette and typography for the DSH Web GUI — paper-white surface, near-black ink and terracotta accent derived from the Codex absolutely theme, warm neutral and accent ramps bound to 82 native token overrides for both light and dark, Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono typography, and interface chrome sized with the content font setting. The fonts are not bundled — install them separately, otherwise the UI falls back to system fonts.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Claude 风格配色与排版——纸白底色、近黑文字与赤陶强调色，在 Codex absolutely 主题基础上重新推导中性色阶与强调色阶，以 82 个原生颜色变量覆盖浅色与深色两套外观；使用 Anthropic Sans、Serif、Mono 三款字体排版，界面外框字号跟随正文设置缩放。字体不随插件分发，需自行安装，否则回退到系统字体。

description.en: Contract suite: one-command install for dsh-legal-intake and dsh-legal-clause.
description.zh: 合同法律插件套装，一条命令装好法律咨询和条款审查两个工具，省去逐个安装的麻烦。

description.en: 用户同意与授权确认：默认勾选、捆绑同意、没有撤回入口 —— 个保法有明确要求。
description.zh: 帮你检查注册页有没有默认勾选、捆绑同意、找不到撤回入口这些个保法不允许的坑。

description.en: 检查依赖树的投毒与风险面：装包即执行的脚本、过宽版本、非 registry 来源
description.zh: 装包前先扫一遍依赖树，揪出会自动执行脚本、版本过宽和非官方来源的投毒风险。

description.en: 密钥轮换：查密钥与证书多久没换、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。
description.zh: 帮你检查密钥和证书多久没换、有没有轮换制度、是否跨环境复用，及早发现安全隐患。

description.en: Route table assigning provider, model, and reasoning effort to subagents by workspace directory prefix; supports global default policy and in-composer session popover.
description.zh: 按工作区目录给子智能体指定 provider、模型与思考等级的路由表：最长前缀匹配后注入子代理配置，支持全局默认策略、设置页规则编辑与会话输入区就地切换。

description.en: 多轮迭代深度检索插件（DeepSeek Harness）：14 平台定向 · 来源可信度分级 A/B/C/D · 交叉验证 · 虚假信息检测 | Multi-round iterative deep-research for DSH
description.zh: 多轮迭代深度检索，跨 14 个平台定向搜索，给来源分级并交叉验证，帮你识别虚假信息。

description.en: A shared browser inside the DeepSeek Harness host: the AI drives it with browser_panel_* tools, and you watch or take over the same tab in the DSH Web UI — logins, 2FA, QR codes included.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里内置一个共享浏览器，AI 用工具自动操作，你也能随时接手同一标签页处理登录和验证码。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）功能增强插件
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一站式功能增强，集成多种实用工具，让开发调试更顺手。

description.en: Translate text-based PDFs via DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible APIs while preserving layout, fonts, images and links, with editable output.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 或兼容 API 翻译文本型 PDF，保留版式、字体、图片与链接，输出可编辑 PDF。

description.en: Update a web-only DSH host from its own web GUI on Windows: read the nightly feed, download the installer, verify its sha512, install it with a detached script, and start the host again.
description.zh: Windows 上从网页界面更新只跑 Web 的 DSH 宿主：读 nightly 更新源、下载安装包、校验 sha512、用独立脚本静默安装，再把宿主重新拉起。

description.en: Adds a research desk inside DSH: searches arXiv, Europe PMC and OpenAlex without an API key, keeps a paper library with full text, answers questions with citations checked verbatim against the source paragraph, writes hypotheses and drafts, produces a multi-perspective review with five viewpoints, runs user-supplied Python or Node scripts in a restricted working directory for verification, and exports the library to Markdown, BibTeX or JSON.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内提供科研工作台：免密钥检索 arXiv、Europe PMC 与 OpenAlex，保存文献库与全文，提问时逐条比对原文校验引用，再生成选题假设与草稿，按五个视角产出多视角综述，在受限工作目录内运行用户提供的 Python 或 Node 脚本做验证计算，并把文献库导出为 Markdown、BibTeX 或 JSON。

description.en: Scores every skill 0-100 from real execution telemetry (load success, follow-up tool errors, user corrections, ignored loads and cost) with 95% confidence intervals, and turns that evidence into fixes the agent can act on.
description.zh: 用真实执行遥测（加载成败、后续工具报错、用户纠正、被忽略与成本）给每个技能打 0-100 分并附 95% 置信区间，再把证据转成 agent 可直接执行的修复建议。

description.en: Takes AES-256-GCM encrypted snapshots of the dsh home on start, on a timer and on dispose, pins the last snapshot before a dsh version change as a pre-upgrade snapshot, and shows status and the restore command in a settings tab; restore runs from the undohaven CLI after dsh quits. Unofficial. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在启动时、定时以及插件卸载时给 dsh 家目录做 AES-256-GCM 加密快照，dsh 版本变化时把上一份快照固定为升级前快照，设置页显示状态和恢复命令；恢复在 dsh 退出后由 undohaven CLI 执行。第三方插件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Manage MCP servers across local AI agents from one panel — read and edit DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and WorkBuddy configs with automatic backups and rollback, and install connectors from the MCP Registry, mcp.so and the local WorkBuddy marketplace.
description.zh: 在一个面板里管理本机各 Agent 的 MCP 服务器——读写 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、WorkBuddy 等配置，写入前自动备份并可回退，还能从 MCP Registry、mcp.so 和本机 WorkBuddy 市场发现并安装连接器。

description.en: Print daily, weekly, monthly, 30-day, 90-day, and all-time token usage and estimated model costs as a receipt, with clipboard image copy and PNG export.
description.zh: Token 账单：把日、周、月、近 30 天、近 90 天与全部周期的 Token 用量及预估模型费用打印成小票，支持复制图片与保存 PNG。

description.en: Console for self-hosted task panels (Qinglong and Daidai) in the sidebar: manage panel connections, environment variables and scheduled tasks over each panel's OpenAPI application credential, with persisted per-resource permission probes and four agent tools for the remaining resources.
description.zh: 在侧栏管理自托管定时面板（青龙 / 呆呆）：用面板的 OpenAPI 应用凭据管理连接、环境变量与定时任务，权限探测结果落库，其余资源由四个智能体工具完成。

description.en: Per-repository and per-session ledger of cache-weighted equivalent tokens: it folds each DSH session into one number, keeps the recent sessions as history, prices an unknown model with the default weights instead of refusing to run, and prints the totals through /te-cost.
description.zh: 按仓库与会话记录缓存加权后的等效 token：把每个 DSH 会话折算成一个数字，保留最近若干会话的历史，遇到未知模型时用默认权重兜底而不是拒绝运行，并通过 /te-cost 打印合计。

description.en: Hides the tools that stayed idle across previous sessions, decided once when a session starts from recorded evidence; it ships disabled, and the compression, skill and image tools are never hidden.
description.zh: 按历史证据隐藏跨会话都未使用的工具，每个会话开始时决定一次；默认关闭，压缩、技能与图片相关工具永不被隐藏。

description.en: Right-sidebar turn list for the current conversation with click-to-jump and user-message filters, plus a branch tree of all conversations with panel-local pinning, drag reordering and archived-session display.
description.zh: 当前会话轮次列表（点击跳转、按用户发言过滤），并用分支树展示所有会话及其分支关系，支持面板内置顶、拖动排序与归档会话展示。

description.en: Registers an exclusion with the built-in session-log plugin so chosen sessions skip session-log upload, either every live session or those whose cwd matches a project name, directory or glob; includes a local status endpoint and an audit command. Does not patch dsh or hook the network. Unofficial.
description.zh: 向内置会话日志插件注册排除规则，让选定会话跳过会话日志上传：可以拦住全部实时会话，也可以只拦 cwd 匹配项目名、目录或 glob 的会话；附带本机状态接口和 audit 体检命令。不改 dsh，不拦网络。第三方插件。

description.en: Learns the command forms and environment-variable repairs a repository needs from tool results, and injects at most four of them, once, when a task starts; a fact that stops being exercised is retired again.
description.zh: 从工具结果里学习该仓库需要的命令形式与环境变量修复，在任务开始时一次性注入至多四条；不再被用到的条目会重新退回淘汰状态。

description.en: Next-line suggestions inside the DSH composer: after each completed turn the host makes one model call and drafts the single sentence you are most likely to say next. While the input is empty it appears as a grey line at the placeholder position — inside the input box, adding no height and never colliding with the goal bar or todo panel. The first Enter moves it into the draft without sending; the second Enter sends. It hides while a turn is streaming or while the input already has text, and each session keeps its own suggestion. (input prediction / prompt suggestion / ghost text)
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里给你写下「下一句」：每轮回答正常结束后，宿主拿这段对话调一次模型，猜出你接下来最可能说的那句话。输入框为空时，它显示在输入框内部、原占位符的位置上，一行灰字，不额外占高度，也不会和目标条、待办面板打架；按第一次 Enter 只把它填进草稿、不发送，按第二次 Enter 才发出去。回答流式输出中或输入框里已有文字时自动隐藏，多条会话各存各的，互不串台。（输入预测 / 提示词建议 / 下一句 / 灰字补全）

description.en: Password-protected entry to the local DSH Web UI: an independent loopback reverse proxy with its own login, no relay server, no account system and no built-in public channel; bring your own tunnel and TLS. It also pins the in-page workspace directory dialog, so creating workspaces works from a remote browser.
description.zh: 本机 DSH Web UI 的密码保护入口：独立回环反向代理自带登录，不提供公网渠道、不经过中转服务器、没有账号体系；公网隧道与 TLS 由你自己接。另把工作区目录选择器固定为页内对话框，远端浏览器也能创建工作区。

description.en: Adds a chip row under the workspace toolbar that filters sessions by Running, Needs confirmation, or Unread, listing every matching session with its workspace, title and age so a click opens it. Each session row also gets a status dot.
description.zh: 在工作区工具栏下方加一排状态 chip，按「运行中 / 待确认 / 未读」筛选会话，列出全部匹配项（工作区·标题·时间）并可直接打开；会话行尾同时显示状态圆点。

description.en: Context metabolism for DSH: every span a compaction removes is archived to local files and replaced with a one-line pointer, so the original words can be recalled later by keyword or date.
description.zh: 上下文代谢：每次压缩掉的原文都归档到本地，只留一行指针；需要细节时按关键词或日期把原话捞回来。

description.en: Store the unsent composer draft in a file on the DSH Host instead of browser localStorage, so the text is back after a reload, a Session switch, a Host restart, or opening the same Session in a second browser or on a phone.
description.zh: 把未发送的输入框草稿存成 DSH 宿主机上的一个文件，而不是留在浏览器 localStorage：刷新、切换会话、重启宿主后草稿还在，换个浏览器或手机打开同一会话也能看到。

description.en: Flat session tags with a persistent done stamp: tags in the sidebar row, the hover card and beside the title, plus a cross-workspace overview with status counts and tag filters.
description.zh: 给会话贴扁平标签并落一枚持久的「完成」章：侧栏行尾、悬停卡片与标题旁都能看到标签，另有跨全部 workspace、按状态计数与标签筛选的会话总览。

description.en: Session management plugin — adds a delete-session action to the workspace session list menu, and supports managing sessions in bulk (archive, delete) from the Settings panel.
description.zh: 会话管理插件 —— 工作区会话列表菜单中添加删除会话功能，设置面板中支持批量管理会话（归档、删除）。

description.en: Adds macOS menu bar access to the existing DeepSeek Harness Desktop window, with native approval prompts and optional notch status and approval cards.
description.zh: 将现有 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 窗口接入 macOS 菜单栏，提供原生审批提示，并可选用刘海状态岛和审批卡片。

description.en: Adds time-bucket grouping (pinned, today, yesterday, this week, earlier) and status tabs (all, running, awaiting, unread) to the DSH sidebar, and labels session rows with their workspace in the flat and time views.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的时间分组视图与状态标签页：置顶、今天、昨天、本周、更早分桶，全部、运行中、待确认、待查看筛选，单列表与按时间视图在每行标出所属工作区。

description.en: Downloads new works from the Pixiv artists you choose, skips anything already downloaded, and can push each sync result to QQ.
description.zh: 按你指定的画师增量下载 Pixiv 新作品，下过的自动跳过，每轮同步结果可推送到 QQ。

description.en: CRT cyber-green theme for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar, top bar, composer and popovers share one palette with scanlines and a small toggle switch at the left of the composer toolbar; colors come from design tokens, so plugins installed later follow automatically.
description.zh: 赛博绿 CRT 配色主题：侧边栏、顶栏、输入框、浮层统一配色并带扫描线，输入框工具条左侧有小开关；配色基于设计令牌，之后新装的插件自动跟随。

description.en: Windows only. One panel for what runs at startup and what can be cleaned or tuned: 11 kinds of registration points (services, scheduled tasks, autostart entries, shell extensions, installed programs, AppX packages, drivers, firewall rules, IFEO hijacks, file associations, credential providers) plus 25 maintenance capabilities. Every write is a dry run first, the registry key is exported before it changes, and UAC is asked once per session.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。一个面板管住「开机会跑什么」和「能清什么、能改什么」：11 类注册点（服务、计划任务、开机自启、外壳扩展、已装程序、AppX 包、驱动、防火墙规则、IFEO 劫持、文件关联、凭据提供程序）加 25 项维护能力。所有写操作先预演，动手前导出要改的注册表键，整个会话只弹一次 UAC。

description.en: Layered, live-reloading context compaction policy for DeepSeek Harness: provider/model rules, ratio or token budgets, summarization-model fallback and a settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层、热加载的上下文压缩策略：按 provider/model 的规则、比例或 token 预算、摘要模型回退与设置面板。

description.en: File-native long-term memory for DSH sessions: Markdown notes, SQLite FTS5 recall, workspace/global scopes, revision conflict handling, and Claude Code import.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供文件原生的长期记忆：Markdown 笔记、SQLite FTS5 召回、workspace/global 作用域、版本冲突处理和 Claude Code 导入。

description.en: Ranked, cost-aware web search and fetch fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness: quality ordering, free-only mode, credentials and per-mode settings on one page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按质量排序、成本感知的网页搜索与抓取回退链：实测排序、free-only、凭据与按模式配置集中在一个设置页。

description.en: One DSH Web bundle that adds session artifacts with Quick Look, Dynamic Workspaces, prompt history, draft memory, interrupted-session recovery, a synced sidebar width and UI element annotation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供会话产物与快速预览、动态工作区、提示历史、草稿附件记忆、中断会话恢复、同步侧栏宽度和 UI 元素标注的一体化插件。

description.en: Browse plugin catalogs, preview index contents and manage custom plugin indexes in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中浏览插件目录、预览索引内容并管理自定义插件索引。

description.en: Named bundle-set presets for the Plugins page: save the active bundle list, edit a preset with switches, preview the difference before applying, switch through the plugin manager, and undo the last switch. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在插件页给 bundle 组合起名：保存当前组合、用开关编辑预设、套用前先看差异，切换由插件管理器执行，并可撤销上一次切换。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Parallel side chat in the right sidebar: reads the main conversation as background and stays read-only, without interrupting it.
description.zh: 右侧栏并行侧边聊天：读取主对话最近文本作为背景，围绕当前任务答疑，只读、不打断主对话。

description.en: Search public job listings by role and city, filter by freshness, save a resume locally, and rank jobs with the DSH model configured by each user.
description.zh: 按岗位与城市搜索公开职位，按时间范围筛选，本地保存简历，并使用每位用户自己的 DSH 模型进行岗位匹配。

description.en: Double-press ArrowUp/ArrowDown in the DSH Web composer to recall this session's sent messages, and restore your draft when you move past the newest one.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框快速连按两次 ↑/↓ 回溯本会话已发送的消息，越过最新一条时恢复草稿。

description.en: Adds a Restart DeepSeek Harness item to the desktop tray. When tasks are running it asks first, with an Electron native dialog whose title and button both read Restart, reusing the official interrupted-tasks notice. The decision path is the same one the tray Quit item uses (inspectQuit plus resolveDesktopQuitPrompt). After a client update replaces main.js the plugin re-applies its small patch on the next start. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端托盘加一项「重启 DeepSeek Harness」。有正在运行的任务时先弹 Electron 原生确认框，标题与按钮都是「重启」，说明沿用官方那句「当前正在运行的任务将会中断」；判断条件与托盘「退出」同源（同一个 inspectQuit 与 resolveDesktopQuitPrompt）。客户端升级替换 main.js 后，插件会在下次启动自动重打补丁。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: ACE Music MCP server for DSH: sign in once with your own account over OAuth, then write full songs, continue a melody from a MusicXML or ABC score, upload audio for transcription, and inspect or download tracks as native acemusic_* tools. Ships a dependency-free MusicXML-to-ABC converter and ACE Music's published writing guides for offline use.
description.zh: 把 ACE Music 的 MCP 服务器接进 DSH：用自己账号走 OAuth 登录一次，之后写完整的歌、按 MusicXML 或 ABC 谱续写旋律、上传音频自动转写、查曲库与下载成品都成为原生 acemusic_* 工具。内置零依赖的 MusicXML→ABC 转换器，以及 ACE Music 官方写作规范的离线副本。

description.en: Folds session events into a durable per-day ledger of requests, input/output/total tokens, cache hit rate, and TPS per provider/model route, with a GitHub-style heatmap in 90/180/365-day windows and time, provider, model, and session filters in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 将会话事件折叠为按天持久化的账本，按供应商/模型路由统计请求数、输入/输出/总 tokens、缓存命中率与 TPS，在侧边栏面板提供 GitHub 风格热力图（90/180/365 天窗口）及时间、供应商、模型、会话筛选。

description.en: Lets Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness, wait for results, and follow up in the same DSH session.
description.zh: 让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 派单、等待结果，并在原 DSH 对话中继续派单。

description.en: Adds an on-demand coding-guidelines skill covering assumptions and tradeoffs, simplicity, surgical changes, and verifiable goals, adapted from Andrej Karpathy's notes on LLM coding pitfalls.
description.zh: 提供按需加载的编码准则技能：先想再写、保持简单、外科手术式修改、以可验证目标推进，源自 Andrej Karpathy 对 LLM 编码陷阱的观察。

description.en: Adds an Overview tab to the DSH conversation view switcher showing the current session's turns, wall time, token usage, cache hit rate and generation speed. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话视图切换器中增加「概览」页签，显示当前会话的回合数、墙面时间、令牌用量、缓存命中率与生成速度。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Screenshot plugin: hover snaps to the window, pane or web element under the cursor; annotated region capture (rectangle, ellipse, arrow, pen, text, mosaic); scrolling capture stitched into one long image with a floating preview; pin-to-screen; the same engine is exposed to the agent as a screenshot tool.
description.zh: 截图插件：鼠标悬停自动吸附窗口 / 应用内模块 / 网页元素，框选截图并标注（矩形、椭圆、箭头、画笔、文字、马赛克），滚屏截图拼接成长图并悬浮预览，可钉住置顶；同一套能力也作为截图工具提供给 Agent 调用。

description.en: Google Lens reverse image search: pass an image URL or a local file to get the Lens result page; with a SerpAPI key it also returns structured matches.
description.zh: 用 Google Lens 反查图片来源：给图片地址或本地文件返回结果页，配 SerpAPI key 可拿到结构化匹配。

description.en: Session cost board for DeepSeek Harness: reads save-token's token counters and prices them with the official DeepSeek table, showing session spend, compression savings and the peak/off-peak delta above the composer.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的会话花费看板：读取 save-token 的 token 统计，按官方价表折成金额，在输入框上方显示本次会话花费、压缩省下的钱与错峰差价。

description.en: Paints an uploaded image, a video file, a direct URL, or one of 6 built-in gradients behind the whole DSH interface, with fill/fit/tile scaling, wallpaper opacity, background blur and a darkening veil. Overrides the primary, canvas and panel design tokens, keeping separate light and dark values, and sets independent opacity for panels, inputs and popovers. Media stays in the browser (IndexedDB) and is never uploaded.
description.zh: 把上传的图片、视频文件、直链 URL 或 6 套内置渐变铺到整个 DSH 界面背后，支持填充/适应/平铺、壁纸可见度、背景模糊与遮罩暗度；覆盖主色/底色/面板色三类设计令牌（深浅模式各一套），并可分别调整面板、输入框、弹层的透明度。素材只留在本机浏览器（IndexedDB），不上传任何服务器。

description.en: Daily Bing wallpapers for DSH Web, with China/US sources, ten image-derived colour styles, and scheduled or system-following light/dark appearance.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供中国与美国来源的每日 Bing 壁纸、十种图片取色风格，以及定时或跟随系统切换的日夜外观。

description.en: Stock analysis workspace for A-shares. Sidebar panel embeds the local stocklab web UI (quotes, LLM stock analysis, market review, hotspots) with a service status light and manual start button, plus a `stocklab` agent tool, FastAPI service supervision, and credential-safe API key injection via the DSH credential store.
description.zh: A股行情分析工作台。左侧栏面板内嵌本地 stocklab 网页工作台（行情、LLM 个股分析、大盘复盘、今日热点），带服务状态灯与一键启动；另含 stocklab 对话工具、FastAPI 服务守护，并通过 DSH 凭据服务安全注入 API Key。

description.en: Gives every AI tool in a repository one shared project memory: an append-only .ai/ work log, a current-state snapshot, and a zoned AGENTS.md whose user zone automation never overwrites. Windows only.
description.zh: 给仓库里的各个 AI 工具共用一份项目记忆：只追加的 .ai/ 工作日志、当前状态快照，以及自动化永不覆盖用户区的分区 AGENTS.md。当前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: A "Development planning and delivery" agent preset in which the expensive main model only plans, dispatches and reviews: four delegation tools (recon, review, scribe, develop) spawn child agents in-process, the build subagent reports straight back to the main window, and a subagent model guard keeps every child on the provider and model chosen on the settings page while the main session is never re-routed. The build subagent may be any preset already installed on the host. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 「开发规划与交付」agent 预设：昂贵主模型只做规划、派工与复核，四个委派工具（recon、review、scribe、develop）在进程内创建子代理，施工子代理完成后直接向主窗口汇报；子代理模型守门把子代理钉在设置页选定的服务商与模型上，主会话永不被改模型。施工子代理可选宿主已安装的任意预设。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds one row to the sidebar that quits DeepSeek Harness Desktop and relaunches it in a single click. It ends both the Electron main process and the host process it spawned, waits for both PIDs to disappear, then starts the app again through a windowless relaunch so no console flashes up. The route only accepts loopback same-origin POSTs and never takes a PID from the request. Windows only. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加一行：一键退出 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 并重启。先结束 Electron 主进程和它拉起的宿主进程、等两个进程都消失后，再以无窗口方式重新启动应用，不会弹出控制台。接口只接受本机同源请求，且不从请求里读取进程号。仅支持 Windows。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A runtime for an agent that lives by its own settings: a 10–60 minute auto-wake grid, three-layer SQLite memory consolidated at night, an auto-evolving persona (nightly rewrite with version history) plus a journal, and WorldGem channels for Bilibili, WeChat and the PetKit feeder.
description.zh: 按设定活着的 agent 运行时：10–60 分钟自动唤醒、夜睡整理的三层 SQLite 记忆、每晚自动演化并保留版本历史的人设与日记，以及 B站 / 微信 / 小佩喂食器 WorldGem 通道。

description.en: A rope-hung mascot at the top edge of the window speaks a short, original healing line on a timer, reminding you to stay with the current task and let outside judgement and public chatter pass; a left-sidebar panel holds a focus dialog, 5–60 minute reminder settings, a show/hide switch and an optional custom mascot image.
description.zh: 窗口顶边挂着一只吉祥物，定时用一句原创的安抚话提醒你专注手头的任务、别被外界评价和舆情带走；左侧栏面板里有专注对话框、5–60 分钟提醒设置、显示开关和可选的自定义图案。

description.en: BugLens turns annotated screenshots and page evidence into guided bug reports, suggests frontend/backend triage and recent assignees, and creates ZenTao bugs with attached materials.
description.zh: 禅图 BugLens，根据截图圈选和页面证据，通过推荐问答补全故障材料，建议前后端排查分工和最近指派人，并附图提交禅道 Bug。

description.en: Session reliability kit: detects reasoning repetition loops and cancels the step, retries reasoning-only empty turns, records raw upstream streams on demand, hands off to a clean session after repeated degeneration, and reloads the renderer with Ctrl+Shift+R.
description.zh: 会话可靠性套件：检测推理重复循环并中止该步、重试只有思考的空轮、按需记录上游原始流、连续退化后交接到干净会话，以及 Ctrl+Shift+R 重载前端。

description.en: Reuse prompts you have typed across DeepSeek Harness conversations: a searchable palette beside the model selector in the composer, a magic-wand optimizer that rewrites the current draft with the session model through an editable system prompt, and a searchable sidebar page over the full prompt history.
description.zh: 复用你在 DeepSeek Harness 各会话中输入过的提示词：输入框模型选择器旁的可搜索面板、用当前会话模型和可编辑的系统提示词改写草稿的魔法棒按钮，以及侧边栏里可搜索的全量提示词历史页。

description.en: Emoji picker in the DSH composer: category tabs and a permanent search box over 200+ Unicode emoji, a Recent tab, and a Mine tab that imports local images or image URLs with a one-line caption. Picking inserts at the caret, closes the panel and returns focus to the composer; imported memes insert "\[meme: caption]" so the model reads what the meme means. Data stays in the browser.
description.zh: DSH 输入框里的表情面板：分类标签 + 常驻搜索框，200 多个 Unicode emoji，另有「最近」和「自定义」——自定义可导入本地图片或图片网址，导入时写一句含义。点选即插到光标处、自动收起并把焦点还给输入框；导入的表情插入「\[表情: 含义]」文本，模型据此理解表情意思。数据只存本机浏览器。

description.en: Deep-sea glass video wallpaper skin for DeepSeek Harness: loop a 1440p clip behind a translucent shell, with three palettes, bilingual controls, bundled music and an account-privacy toggle.
description.zh: 把 1440p 深海视频循环播放为 DeepSeek Harness 的半透明玻璃壁纸，内置夜光珊瑚、深海极光、极光潮汐三套配色，中英双语控制面板、背景音乐和账号隐私开关。

description.en: Reading aids for the DSH chat transcript: gradient text, a reading ruler, line and block focus, and colour bands. Visual overlays only; the message text, selection and copy are untouched.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天正文增加阅读辅助：渐变文字、阅读尺、逐行/逐段聚焦与色块分段。只做视觉叠加，不改动正文、选择和复制。

description.en: You type one line and the agent guesses the rest; this plugin rewrites that line into a complete prompt with goal, scope and acceptance criteria and waits for your go-ahead before the agent touches anything, then lets you approve it, ask for a rewrite, send the original as-is, or walk away — in which case the original goes ahead after 15 minutes.
description.zh: 你只打了一句话，剩下的全靠模型猜——这个插件先把这句话改写成一份完整提示词（目标、范围、验收标准），动手之前先交给你过目：你可以确认、提出修改、或直接按原话发送；如果 15 分钟不处理，它也会按原话继续。

description.en: SSH remote development for DSH: register hosts, mirror their remote Sessions into the sidebar, and use the terminal and files over one tunnel.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机接入 DSH：登记主机、把远端 Session 镜像进侧边栏，并经单一隧道使用远端终端与文件。

description.en: APIPod image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接生成图片和视频，创作素材不用切工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle that registers the DeepAI Code model catalog and routes every turn across a capability-ordered Frontier-to-Unmetered model ladder with hot failover, an SSE idle watchdog and live catalog sync.
description.zh: 把 DeepAI Code 模型目录接进 DSH，用 Auto 虚拟模型自动按能力排序选模型，挂了就热切换，还能盯着 SSE 空闲。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: one click rewrites your composer draft into a ready-to-send prompt with the current model and this conversation's context. Composer button, /enhance command, enhance_prompt tool, in-plugin settings.
description.zh: 一键把草稿改写成可直接发送的提示词，自动带上当前模型和对话上下文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 搜索与进度反馈插件：大仓库搜索加速，慢任务先看进展。
description.zh: 大仓库搜索自动加速，慢任务先看进展，不用干等命令行卡住。

description.en: Server resource monitor for DeepSeek Harness: CPU, memory, disk, GPU/NPU/DCU, processes and Docker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏实时查看本地和 SSH 服务器的 CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU/NPU/DCU、进程和 Docker 占用情况。

description.en: Render acceleration for long, formula-heavy conversations in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: CSS content-visibility containment + spinner quieting, with live config switches.
description.zh: 给长对话和公式多的页面加速渲染，用 CSS 隔离和加载动画静默让界面更流畅，还能实时开关配置。

description.en: Agent 原生产物空间：分级写入（新建自动归位 / 修改待确认）+ 固定修订引用。对标 WorkBuddy 资料库的 DSH 插件。
description.zh: 让 Agent 产出的文件自动归位到资料库，新建免确认、修改待确认，还能固定引用继续加工。

description.en: DSH 插件：在会话中读取飞书文档、wiki 与消息，并把修改写回飞书。
description.zh: 在对话里直接读飞书文档、wiki 和消息，改完还能写回去，不用开飞书客户端。

description.en: 只读监控 HGDB / PostgreSQL 14+：实时总览、会话与阻塞链、Top SQL、复制状态，并向 Harness 提供 8 个 AI 查询工具。
description.zh: 只读监控 HGDB/PostgreSQL 14+，实时看会话阻塞、Top SQL 和复制状态，还能让 AI 在对话里直接查。

description.en: 一个为ai提供一生的插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 加一副身体和一段人生，会饿会累会老，还会记仇后悔，最后会死。

description.en: 自由额度与积分聚合 + API 价格表 + 按模型折算本机 token 花费（峰谷价 / 缓存命中 / fork 去重 / 官方 CSV 对账）
description.zh: 聚合各家 AI 免费额度和 API 价格，还能按模型算出本机 token 花了多少钱。

description.en: AI Usage Monitor for DeepSeek Harness: live tokens, context headroom, per-call provider/model routing and estimated USD cost in a left-sidebar panel with a floating mini card and an EN/ES toggle. Author: Alejavi Rivera (YouTube @alejavirivera).
description.zh: 在左侧边栏实时查看 token 消耗、上下文余量和预估美元成本，还能按服务商和模型拆分，一眼看清钱花在哪。

description.en: DSH 纯对话模式插件：零编码工具的 chat preset、独立 chat 工作区自动归组；对话界面全部由官方 UI 呈现，显示文案中英双语。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一个纯聊天模式，不带任何编码工具，对话界面用官方 UI，中英双语显示。

description.en: Markdown in, client-grade printable HTML report out: one self-contained file with a branded cover page, a table of contents auto-built from H2/H3 with anchors that resolve, body typography, and a running footer. Print rules are the point — A4 `@page` with 2cm margins, table rows that never split across pages, repeating table headers, headings kept with their content. Brand colour is WCAG-checked: links and TOC numbers are darkened to reach 4.5:1 on white, cover text switches between black and white by luminance, and `#rrggbbaa` is composited first. Open the file and press Ctrl+P to export the PDF; no external CSS/JS/fonts, no browser engine.
description.zh: Markdown 进，客户级可打印 HTML 报告出：单文件、无外部 CSS/JS/字体，含品牌色封面、由 H2/H3 自动生成且锚点可跳转的目录、正文排版与页脚。核心是打印规则——A4 `@page` 2cm 页边距、表格行不被分页切断、表头每页重复、标题不与正文分离。品牌色按 WCAG 校验：链接与目录编号自动压深到白底 4.5:1 以上，封面文字按亮度在黑/白间切换，`#rrggbbaa` 先合成再计算。生成后浏览器打开按 Ctrl+P 即可导出 PDF，不依赖浏览器内核。

description.en: Adds a breathing glow border around the message composer, with six selectable colors.
description.zh: 为消息输入区添加呼吸光晕边框，内置六种可选颜色。

description.en: File plugin — adds a Files tab to the session tab bar that shows the file tree of the workspace, with preview and editing.
description.zh: 文件插件 —— 在会话标签栏中新增文件标签页，展示工作区对应的文件树，支持预览/编辑文件。

description.en: A sidebar credential vault for DeepSeek Harness that stores accounts, passwords and API keys locally, with an access lock and an agent read tool. Secrets are masked by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏凭据保险箱，在本地保存账号、密码和 API Key，支持访问密码锁定与 Agent 读取工具，密钥默认脱敏。

description.en: DeepWiki MCP connector for DeepSeek Harness - a configuration-only DSH bundle that adds the public DeepWiki MCP server over Streamable HTTP and exposes read_wiki_structure, read_wiki_contents and ask_wiki_question as mcp__deepwiki__* tools. Author: Alejavi Rivera.
description.zh: 把 DeepWiki 的 MCP 服务接进 DSH，让你直接查仓库文档结构、内容和问答。

description.en: Design audit that returns the fix, not advice: Babel parses the pasted JSX/TSX into a real AST, hardcoded hex colours in colour properties and JSX colour props are rewritten to `var(--color-*)` tokens by hue family and lightness band, and the result comes back as a unified diff — edits are spliced into the original source by node offsets, so quotes, indentation and the rest of the file stay untouched. Deprecated components are flagged but never renamed, because an unverified rename compiles and then breaks props; semi-transparent colours are reported without a rewrite. Nothing is written to disk, and nothing is done with regex.
description.zh: 设计审计直出修复代码：用 Babel 把粘贴的 JSX/TSX 解析成真正的 AST，把颜色属性与 JSX 颜色 prop 里的硬编码十六进制改成 `var(--color-*)` Token（按色相归族、按明度归档），并以 unified diff 返回——改写按节点源码区间拼接，引号、缩进和文件其余部分原样保留。废弃组件只报告不改名（未经核对的重命名能编译通过但会打断 props），半透明颜色只报告不改写。不落盘，也不用正则替换。

description.en: Sidebar developer utilities for JSON, timestamp, UUID, hash, AES, Base64, Diff, and model-backed translate, with pinable tabs and agent tools.
description.zh: 侧栏开发者工具，覆盖 JSON、时间戳、UUID、Hash、AES、Base64、Diff 与宿主模型翻译，支持 Pin 到 Tab，并向 Agent 暴露工具。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and a small pill appears: translate, explain, quote into a new DSH session, save to a spaced-repetition vocabulary book, or copy. Works without switching windows, and the card never steals focus.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 程序里选中文字，旁边冒出一个小胶囊：翻译、解释、引用到新的 DSH 会话、存入按遗忘曲线复习的生词本，或者直接复制。不用切窗口，浮窗也不抢焦点。

description.en: GEO audit to fix pack: fetch one URL with the platform fetch (10s timeout, redirects, charset-aware decoding, 2MB cap) and score 11 weighted checks — title length, meta description, single H1 plus H2s, Organization and WebSite JSON-LD, `/llms.txt`, canonical, `<html lang>`, image alt coverage, page-level structured data, robots indexability — then write the two files the site is missing: `llms.txt` built from the page outline and `jsonld.html` with ready-to-paste Organization/WebSite JSON-LD, alongside an HTML audit report with the fix list ordered by weight. No browser, no third-party dependency.
description.zh: GEO 体检与自动修复：输入一个网址，用原生 fetch 抓取（10 秒超时、跟随重定向、按 content-type 解码、2MB 截断）并做 11 项加权体检——title 长度、meta description、唯一 H1 与 H2、Organization/WebSite JSON-LD、根目录 `/llms.txt`、canonical、`<html lang>`、图片 alt 覆盖率、页面级结构化数据、robots 是否允许索引——然后直接产出站点缺的两个文件：由页面大纲生成的 `llms.txt` 与可直接粘贴的 `jsonld.html`，另附按权重排序的 HTML 体检报告。不启浏览器、零第三方依赖。

description.en: Hibernate or shut down Windows once every DeepSeek Harness task has finished — waits for all agents and background jobs, then shows a cancellable 60-second countdown. Any new task voids it.
description.zh: 所有 DeepSeek Harness 任务跑完后，自动让 Windows 休眠或关机，带 60 秒可取消倒计时。

description.en: Three GUI toolkits in one bundle: whole-page zoom (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + =, - and 0, with a coordinate shim so anchored menus stay on their buttons), copy-on-select in the chat transcript (copies the dragged text and tells you how many characters, with an execCommand fallback), and Mermaid fences in replies drawn as diagrams with a full-screen viewer (wheel zoom anchored at the pointer, drag to pan) and PNG, SVG or source copy. The Mermaid engine ships inside the bundle, so nothing is fetched at runtime.
description.zh: 一个包里三个界面工具：整页缩放（Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + =、-、0，并带有坐标补偿，缩放后菜单仍贴着触发按钮）；聊天记录划词即复制（复制拖选的文字并提示字符数，带 execCommand 兜底）；回复里的 Mermaid 围栏直接画成图，可全屏查看（滚轮以指针为锚点缩放、拖动平移），并支持复制 PNG / SVG / 源码。Mermaid 引擎随包内置，运行时不发起任何网络请求。

description.en: Hide a workspace from the sidebar without deleting it, and restore hidden workspaces or archived sessions from one manager.
description.zh: 把工作区从侧栏隐藏而不删除注册，并在同一个管理器里恢复已隐藏的工作区或已归档的会话。

description.en: On-call incident full chain: `oncall_start` classifies an alert into a fault family (timeout / error-rate / resource / dependency / data) and returns ranked likely causes plus a branch-specific checklist; `mitigate` records every action and its result on a timeline and re-plans the next steps from that family, dropping steps already tried; `postmortem` writes postmortem.md (and an HTML copy) with a sorted timeline, key actions, and MTTR measured from the first effective mitigation. Rule-based and local-only: no network, no model call, state kept in incident.json next to the workspace.
description.zh: 故障全链路：`oncall_start` 把告警归到故障族（超时/错误率/资源/依赖/数据），给出按可能性排序的根因与对该族的分支排查清单；`mitigate` 把每个动作与结果记进时间线，并按故障族重算下一步、自动剔除已经试过的动作；`postmortem` 生成 postmortem.md（同时输出一份 HTML），时间线按发生时间排序，MTTR 取「最早一次有效缓解」而不是最后一次动作。纯规则、本地运行，不联网、不调模型，状态落在工作区的 incident.json。

description.en: Man！花了这么多钱！— DSH 每轮费用提醒：按金额分四档情绪的科比冰红茶探头，二十句离线语音，常用金额整句播报。
description.zh: 每轮结束科比冰红茶探头报账，按花费分四档情绪播报金额或 Token，花钱越多越兴奋。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: control Mi Home (米家) devices through mijiaAPI — device tiles, device detail pages, scenes and consumables in a sidebar workbench. · 通过 mijiaAPI 控制米家设备的 DSH 插件，侧栏工作台复刻米家 App 的设备页。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏直接控制米家设备，看设备卡片、详情、场景和耗材，像用米家 App 一样顺手。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot button for the DSH composer (Windows): region capture with window-edge snapping plus a brush/crop editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里加个微信式截图按钮，框选自动吸附窗口边缘，编辑后一键插入对话。

description.en: Runs bash commands on Windows through Niubash as a DSH tool alongside the built-in pwsh, with a bundled troubleshooting skill.
description.zh: 通过 Niubash 在 Windows 上以 DSH 工具运行 bash 命令，与内置 pwsh 共存，并随包内置排障技能。

description.en: DSH 右侧边栏浏览器的沉浸式双语网页翻译：原文保留、译文插入其下，支持整站自动翻译、滚动续翻与引擎切换
description.zh: 在右侧边栏浏览器里做沉浸式双语网页翻译，原文保留、译文插在下面，还能整站自动翻、滚动续翻和换引擎。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: DeepSeek halves its rates off-peak. A small sun or moon in the composer shows which rate is live, plus your balance and today's spend.
description.zh: 在输入框旁用小太阳或月亮显示当前是高峰还是低谷价，还能看余额和今日花费。

description.en: Read-only DSH command that audits which model routes a session used and flags calls outside a configurable allowlist.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 命令，审计会话使用过的模型路由，并标记白名单之外的调用。

description.en: Read-only DSH command that exports the current session as redacted Markdown or JSON.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 命令，把当前会话导出为脱敏的 Markdown 或 JSON。

description.en: Saves the Plugins page as named scenes of plugin bundles, MCP servers and skills, then applies a scene as a minimal diff with undo, a composer shortcut, and a refusal to switch while a chat is running.
description.zh: 把官方「插件」页的启用状态连同 MCP 服务器与技能开关存成场景；应用时只改有差异的行并支持撤销，输入框旁可直接切换，有会话运行中则拒绝切换。

description.en: Structured Socratic tutoring and skill tracking for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在对话里带你按课程一步步学，一次一问，并用 0–5 分记录技能掌握情况。

description.en: Deals board for DeepSeek Harness: 255 seeded deals plus radar and free-token boards, seven agent tools, a full-page sidebar panel, and a refresh skill that verifies amounts and thresholds against official sources only. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 薅羊毛情报看板：255 条种子优惠，另有雷达、免费 Token 两个副榜；七个智能体工具、侧边栏整页看板页，以及金额与门槛只认官方来源的复核技能。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH plugin: Apifox-style API workspace (docs, debug, mock, schema, env, history, tests, import/export, flow, search) in the official right sidebar
description.zh: 在右侧栏里搭一套 Apifox 风格的接口工作区，写文档、调接口、Mock、跑测试全都能干，数据存本地不用账号。

description.en: An agent preset that runs the first step of every turn on a strong model to reason and lay down the plan, then continues the following steps on a weak model; both sides are picked from the model catalog in Settings, and Prewalk sessions also get compact strong/weak dropdowns beside the composer.
description.zh: 新增一个 agent preset：每个 turn 的第一步用强模型做推理并把计划立起来，之后的步骤交给弱模型执行；两个模型可在设置页从模型目录里挑，Prewalk 会话的输入区还会多出「强 / 弱」两个紧凑下拉。

description.en: Rewrites prompt drafts, suggests a conversation mode, and recommends relevant skills.
description.zh: 改写提示词草稿、建议对话模式，并推荐相关技能。

description.en: Local document search for DSH: eight kb_* tools that ingest Markdown, TXT, PDF, DOCX, HTML and JSON into workspace- and session-scoped indexes, returning matching passages with path, chapter and line-range citations; BM25 by default with optional dense retrieval, fully offline and host-only.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地文档检索：八个 kb_* 工具把 Markdown、TXT、PDF、DOCX、HTML、JSON 建成工作区/会话分层索引，返回带路径、章节与行号的原文片段；默认 BM25，可选稠密检索，全程离线、仅宿主侧。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：透明模式远程开发——标准 read/write/edit/bash/glob/grep、Skill、MCP 直接跑在 SSH 主机；本地镜像 + 远端文件树 + 按需导入本机附件
description.zh: 让 read/write/bash 等工具直接跑在 SSH 远端主机上，本地镜像同步，远程开发像在本地一样顺手。

description.en: Task planner for DeepSeek Harness: stages a project into daily tasks with buffer days, a capacity board, evening review, a pinned assistant chat, and a fish task popover in every conversation header. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的任务规划助手：把项目拆成每日任务，支持缓冲日、容量看板、晚间复盘、置顶助手会话，以及每个对话标题前的小鱼任务浮层。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Meter your DeepSeek spend in the sidebar: balance, today's cost, input/output tokens, peak and off-peak pricing, per-session breakdown — and a daily budget that brakes before it bites.
description.zh: 侧栏实时显示 DeepSeek 余额、今日花费和 token 用量，还能设每日预算，超支自动暂停调用。

description.en: Close out a context stage before compaction, and hand the next stage a reviewable markdown file instead of a summary. A plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在上下文压缩前收尾当前阶段，把成果整理成可审阅的 Markdown 文件交给下一阶段，而不是只给摘要。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: use local Codex and Claude Code subscription CLIs as models and child agents
description.zh: 把本地 Codex 和 Claude Code 订阅直接当模型和子代理用，省下额外 API 开销。
